name: ITY Accessibility Toolbar
author: Ishita Ray

sections.description:
Accessibility Toolbar adds a floating button panel to any WordPress website, letting users:
– Increase and decrease font size
– Toggle high-contrast mode for better readability
– Customize colors from backend settings
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/accessibility-toolbar directory, or install it via the WordPress admin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen.
  3. Configure settings from Settings > Accessibility Toolbar.
sections.faq:
Is it support all sizes of content to resize?
-Yes, if you apply font sizes through customiser it will work. But it will not work if apply any custom sizes with css.

What is most important to do with the WordPress site for full support?
-All content colour and font size need to maintain through customiser. Otherwise it will not override.

We can here all content from the website with this tool?
-Yes we can select the text and then click on listen button to hear it.

short_description: Adds a simple accessibility toolbar for changing font sizes and toggling high-contrast mode.
